objective: Take General Drakkisath's Command to Marshal Maxwell in Burning Steppes.
start: Dropped by Overlord Wyrmthalak in Blackrock Spire

description: From the corpse of the defeated serpent you uncover what appears to be a note of some importance: A letter from his superior, General Drakkisath, concerning protocol.
Your instinct tells you that you should take it to Marshal Maxwell.

note: Leads to General Drakkisath's Demise in Upper Blackrock Spire.
pickup: General Drakkisath's Command (drops from Overlord Wyrmthalak)
turnin: Marshal Maxwell, Morgan's Vigil, Burning Steppes
